After my consultation about orthodontic treatment, I was very impressed with the service. The clinic is incredibly clean (with a million 'k's!). This clinic made me more confident about the results.
What I really liked was the clinic's management system. Appointments are very systematic, and they send reminders via LINE in advance, so I never had to wait in long queues. As for cleanliness, it's top-notch. All the equipment is opened and used in front of you, giving you 100% confidence in its safety.
I've been undergoing treatment for about 2 years now, and the results are very satisfying. I can smile with much more confidence. The doctor gave straightforward advice and didn't push unnecessary courses. The price is reasonable for the quality I received. If you're looking for a clinic that focuses on quality and international standards, this is the place. I highly recommend it.
